verse.text: But if you refuse to serve the Lord, then choose today whom you will serve. Would you prefer the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates? Or will it be the gods of the Amorites in whose land you now live? But as for me and my family, we will serve the Lord.

video.title: "Leading Your Family in Service to the Lord" | Joshua 24:15 (Father's Day Devotional)

reflection: Joshua didn't wait for his household to figure out faith on their own—he made the call and led the way. That's the job: not being perfect, just being the one who decides, out loud, what your home stands for. Say it plainly to your kids today, then back it up before bedtime with one small, visible act of faith.
